page.overview:
Who is Darrus Jeht?

Darrus Jeht, a member of the Jedi Order, was a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Kromus and the Battle of Cularin, Jeht was the commanding officer of the Galactic Republic's Maelstrom-class battle cruiser Maelstrom, which served with distinction in both battles.

In the current Star Wars canon, Darrus Jeht was introduced in the Star Wars Roleplaying sourcebook Lead by Example, which was published by Fantasy Flight Games in 2016 for the Star Wars: Age of Rebellion roleplaying game system.
